references.collectionNotes: The Ministry of the Environment (ME) tasked the National Waste Agency (AND) with carrying out a national quantification study of DMA. This study aims to weigh the quantity of waste produced door to door, in order to have more reliable and precise data.

references.collectionNotes: Measure the MSW Production Ratio of samples of residents in as many areas and with as much variety as possible (at a minimum, urban and rural). It is based on the determination of the composition of waste from samples. Constitution of the sample to sort it using a composite sorting table is taken for three days in a row, randomly at the source at the level of regrouping points.
